title: Etherea
tagline: Gamified learning platform designed to teach blockchain and Web3 concepts, where users earn tokens with real-world value as they progress through engaging educational content.
description:
The project is a gamified learning platform focused on blockchain and Web3 education, designed to be beginner-friendly while offering depth for enthusiasts. Users can log in through email, Google, or wallet options. For users without a wallet, the system automatically generates one, ensuring accessibility.

Upon registration, each user is gifted a personalized NFT with initial attributes for strength, health, and defense set to zero. Learning happens progressively through structured lessons and mini-games. Users earn coins and EXP by completing these tasks: coins are used to unlock premium content like masterclasses, while EXP levels up the user, allowing them to enhance one attribute of their NFT.

As users complete chapters, they receive unique NFTs as badges of accomplishment, which are stored in their wallets. The platform also features a leaderboard showcasing users' levels and streaks, fostering competition and engagement. This dynamic approach combines education, entertainment, and tangible rewards, making learning blockchain and Web3 concepts both fun and rewarding.
how_its_made: We have used Nex.tjs for frontend and typescript for backend. We enabled normal user to login through email and google through the help of Dynamic and we have use flow to deploy our smart contracts alongside with Blockscout to verify our contracts. As mentioned above, dynamic allows normal user to get onboard easier in a web3 application.
